meta.title: Strategy leaderboard
meta.state_of_the_board: No strategy has been scored. Not one. Every entry is blocked at G0 because no odds archive exists (F-04) and, for props and parlays, no leg-level outcome data exists (F-09). The board therefore ranks readiness-to-evaluate, not performance, and says so on every row.
meta.why_publish_an_empty_board: Because an empty board is the true state, and filling it with hypothetical results would be the exact failure this project exists to avoid. The scoring formula and reward tiers are complete and will populate automatically once G0 clears.

scoring.composite: 0.40 * z(mean CLV) + 0.30 * z(shrunk out-of-sample ROI) + 0.20 * stability_score + 0.10 * capacity_score
scoring.shrinkage: shrunk_ROI = ROI * n/(n + 400). With 400 graded bets, half of a measured ROI is treated as signal and half as noise. This is what stops a 30-bet heater from leading.
scoring.stability_score: fraction of the 4 segments (home/away, fav/dog, half-season, conference) in which the edge sign agrees
scoring.z: computed cross-sectionally across admitted strategies only
scoring.tie_break: lower trial count wins, then earlier pre-registration timestamp

grading_spec.price: the price recorded at submission time, immutable
grading_spec.push: refunded, excluded from ROI but counted in n
grading_spec.line_move: does not re-grade a placed bet, ever
grading_spec.source_of_truth: closing line from the single declared book and snapshot rule

strategies.name: Rating-mismatch spread
strategies.thesis: Bet when the model's margin disagrees with the market by more than a declared threshold, and the disagreement is not explained by information the market has and the model does not (injuries, weather, rest).
strategies.rule: If |model_margin - market_margin| >= 2.0 points after an injury adjustment, take the side the model prefers at the best available price.
strategies.verdict: BLOCKED at G0 — no odds archive (F-04). The model exists; the market does not.
strategies.risk_note: The model currently lacks opponent adjustment, so most 'disagreements' with a sharp market would be model error, not edge.

strategies.name: Pythagorean luck regression
strategies.thesis: Clubs whose win total runs ahead of their scoring margin should regress. This build measures that gap directly: 76.7% of win-pct variance is explained by scoring margin, leaving 23.3% as the pool where luck lives.
strategies.rule: Fade clubs with luck_wins >= +1.5, back clubs with luck_wins <= -1.5, only while the market has not already priced the regression.
strategies.current_examples: Denver +2.01 and Cleveland +1.99 expected wins above margin; Tampa Bay -2.48 and Houston -1.59 below. See the Luck page.
strategies.verdict: BLOCKED at G0. The signal is computed from official data; the test is impossible without prices.
strategies.risk_note: The 'luck' residual also contains real information the margin misses (special teams, clutch play, opponent quality). Treating all of it as luck would be an error, and this is the main way this strategy can be wrong.

strategies.name: Rest and schedule asymmetry
strategies.thesis: Unequal rest (Thursday games, bye weeks, international travel) is a priced-in discount that is sometimes mispriced. This season has nine international games and a Week 11 schedule change, so the population of unusual spots is unusually large.
strategies.rule: Flag games with rest differential >= 3 days or a travel-time zone change >= 5 hours; require a model edge beyond the declared threshold.
strategies.verdict: BLOCKED at G0. Schedule facts are verifiable; the effect size is not estimable here.
strategies.risk_note: Small effects, heavily studied by the market. The prior should be that any edge is already gone.

strategies.name: Divisional compression
strategies.thesis: Familiarity compresses margins. The measured correlation between division form and overall form is only +0.33 (p=0.066, n=32), i.e. division results carry real but modest extra information.
strategies.rule: In divisional games, shade the underdog and the under. Reject if the market total already sits below the model total by the declared threshold.
strategies.risk_note: C6 is a cross-sectional correlation, not an effect estimate on margins. Using it as an effect size would be a category error.

strategies.name: Two-leg same-game parlay (team total + spread)
strategies.thesis: Two legs on the same team are strongly positively correlated, so an independent-leg price overpays the bettor. The engine quantifies the size of that mispricing for any rho.
strategies.rule: Price the joint with a Gaussian copula and estimated rho; bet only if the offered SGP price exceeds the copula fair price by the declared margin.
strategies.verdict: BLOCKED at G0 and G9 — no SGP prices and no leg-level dataset to estimate rho (F-09).
strategies.risk_note: Books apply their own correlation adjustment. If their rho is better estimated than ours, the 'edge' is our error.

strategies.name: Two-leg cross-game parlay
strategies.thesis: Legs in different games are close to independent, so the product rule is roughly valid. The book's parlay price is therefore the fair product minus a hold — a pure price-taking bet with no informational edge.
strategies.rule: Never bet without a leg-level edge; the parlay multiplier cannot create one.
strategies.verdict: BLOCKED at G0. Included on the board deliberately as the control case: if this strategy ever shows profit, suspect the grading, not the skill.
strategies.risk_note: Compounding the book's margin across legs. Structurally -EV unless each leg carries a real edge.

strategies.name: Quarterback-out offence fade
strategies.thesis: A verified starting-QB absence is the largest single availability shock in the sport. The injury report makes the absence official; the market has to reprice it.
strategies.rule: If the starting QB is Out or Doubtful on the official report, apply the declared QB weight to the team's model rating and require a residual edge.
strategies.current_examples: Week 10 verified designations include Kyler Murray (MIN, did not participate, no game status yet) and TreVeyon Henderson (NE, Out, illness).
strategies.verdict: BLOCKED at G0, and additionally dependent on Q-09 for the 'starting QB' determination.
strategies.risk_note: Without a verified depth order, 'the starter' is an assumption. That is why Q-09 is a P0 question.

strategies.name: Secondary attrition versus the pass
strategies.thesis: Cornerback and safety attrition is the defensive analogue of a QB absence, and it is visible on the official report by position.
strategies.rule: Count verified CB/S unavailability, weight by the declared defensive-back weights, and compare the repriced total with the market.
strategies.current_examples: Verified Week 10 examples: Carlton Davis III (NE, CB, knee, Out); Malik Harrison (NYG, LB, groin, Questionable); D.J. Reed (DET, CB, did not participate, no status yet).
strategies.verdict: BLOCKED at G0. The availability half is verified; the valuation half is an explicit assumption (A-04).
strategies.risk_note: Position weights are the weak link. Publish both a low and a high weight set and require the signal to survive both (SG-15).

strategies.name: Running-back workload prop
strategies.thesis: Opportunity drives production. A back whose snap share and carry share are verified rising is mispriced if the market lags usage.
strategies.rule: Project attempts from recent share, convert to yards with a per-carry distribution, and price the over. Blocked unless the player is confirmed active.
strategies.verdict: BLOCKED at G0, G10 — no usage data (Q-03) and no confirmation route for participation.
strategies.risk_note: Usage models overfit to the last two games. Needs the full season's distribution, not a hot stretch.

strategies.name: Receiver target-share prop
strategies.thesis: Target share is stickier than yards per target. Price the volume, let the efficiency vary.
strategies.rule: Project targets from verified share, convert with the player's own distribution; require the offered line to sit at least one standard deviation from the projection.
strategies.risk_note: The verified Week 10 report lists several pass-catchers with practice limitations and no game status — a reminder that the prop decision point is after the deadline, not before it.

strategies.name: Three-leg same-game script parlay
strategies.thesis: QB passing yards + WR receiving yards + team total over share a common driver. The equicorrelated factor model shows the joint probability is materially higher than the product of the legs.
strategies.rule: Price with the three-leg copula; require the offered price to exceed the copula fair price by the declared margin; reject if rho cannot be estimated.
strategies.verdict: BLOCKED at G0, G9, G10. Highest variance of anything here; the most gate exposure; the most attractive to overconfident operators. That combination is why G9/G10 are hard gates.
strategies.risk_note: Highest model risk on the board. Even a correct rho can be wrong enough to flip the sign of the EV.

strategies.name: Availability-adjusted line versus market
strategies.thesis: The full pipeline: model line, then adjust for verified availability, then compare with the market. This is the strategy the whole project exists to build.
strategies.rule: Model margin -> availability adjustment (A-04 weights) -> compare with market -> bet the residual above threshold.
strategies.verdict: BLOCKED at G0. Two of its five inputs do not exist yet (market, depth order).
strategies.risk_note: Compounds every other risk: model error, weight error, depth error, and market error.
